summary.text: Katie Wallace, a Democrat, represents District 17 (Boulder and Weld counties) in the Colorado State Senate.

paragraphs.text: She was appointed to the seat in 2025, succeeding Sonya Jaquez Lewis, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 special general election for the seat.
She earned an associate degree from Front Range Community College in 2016 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2018.
Her career includes working on political campaigns as a legislative assistant and a community organizer.
